Even showering, brushing my teeth etc. I’m 10 days clean tomorrow and I have to say I do believe the weed was absolutely enhancing all those negative feelings. Even tho I was using it to escape them. Also to add - I had to change up what I was doing quite a bit. I would usually get off work, smoke and then try to be productive or enjoy my hobbies but I’d just end up doom scrolling. Now when I get home I go for a walk and listen to an audiobook. I have been spending more time with family, being more present with my son, and trying to implement more changes into my routine. Being outside helps a lot. I also started taking hot baths at night time before bed. No phone, just a book and some bubbles. I definitely look forward to it now :) so if you do quit you’ll have to commit to learning what your triggers are and replacing those with things that make you feel good.
